2 ” to allow audio playback Hallo learner, welcome to Science and Technology lesson for Grade 4. Today we are going to learn how to make floaters sink. We are going to learn how to make floaters sink. Welcome to the program. Matter is anything that occupies space and has mass. We have three states of matter; solids, liquids and gases. This different solids sink while others float, in the different state of matter we have solids, some solids sink while other solids float. Before we begin listen to this poem of sinkers and floaters. *Music* Sinkers and floaters A plasticine ball sinks, A plasticine boat floats, I know why! The shape of the material. A coin sinks, A leaf floats, I know why! The type of the material. A short pencil floats, A long pencil also floats, I know why! The size of the material. *Music* Learner, the poem is about sinkers and floaters. Learner, what are floaters? Can you name three examples of floaters? *Music* The objects that remain at the surface of water are floaters. They normally float, or the materials that are floaters include: a pencil, a leaf, a paper and many others. Now tell me what are sinkers and name three examples of sinkers. Learner, tell me what are sinkers? And name three examples of sinkers. *Music* Solids that sink in water or they go at the bottom of the water are sinkers. Solids that sink in water or they go at the bottom of the water are sinkers. Sinkers include a stone, a key, a coin, any material made of metal and many others. Learner, name factors or reasons that affect floating and sinking. Name factors or reasons that affect floating and sinking. *Music* From the poem, we hear that the type and shape of the material affects whether an item floats or sinks. The type and shape of the material affects whether an item floats or sinks. A plasticine ball sinks while a plasticine boat floats . Learner, which factor makes the plasticine ball to sink and the plasticine boat to float? Answer when you hear the music. *Music*

3 ” to allow audio playback The factor is the shape. The material is the same, that is, plasticine. The material is the same, that is, plasticine. But the different shapes made from the plasticine affects floating and sinking. *Music* A coin sinks while a leaf floats. Again we hear from the poem a coin sinks while a leaf floats. The shape of a coin is different from that of a leaf . Learner, looking at a leaf and a coin which factor affecting floating and sinking do we notice? Is it the shape or the material. *Music* A coin sinks while a leaf floats because of the type of the material. Even though a coin and a leaf do not have the same shape the material is different. Remember the materials that sink are called sinkers while those that float are called floaters, and the type of material always affects floating and sinking. The type of material always affect floating and sinking. Different materials float while different materials sink, if you look at a ship, a ship floats on water because it has a hollow shape. Shape is a factor affecting floating and sinking. A piece of wood floats on water while a piece of metal sinks in water. The type of material affects floating and sinking. A short pencil and a long pencil float on water whether it is short or it is long it doesn’t affect. Size will not affect floating and sinking. I want us to find out this question, can floaters be made to sink? can floaters be made to sink? *Music* Yes floaters can be made to sink, by adding more weight to the floater. From the poem, a plasticine boat is a floater because it floats. If we add some weight to the boat, like we add coins or stones, the plasticine boat will sink. Therefore adding more weight to the floater will make the floater to sink. *Music* Learner, name an example of a floater and how you can make it a sinker. Name an example of a floater and how you can make it a sinker . *Music* A pencil floats on water but when you tie it to a stone it will sink. When you tie a floater to a heavy object, then the floater will sink. Floaters can be made to sink by adding weight on them. Even a ship which floats on water if you overload it then it will sink. We can therefore make floaters to sink and the main way of making floaters to sink is by adding more weight to the floater. *Music* This is your homework. F ind other floaters that can be made to sink. Show your parents or guardians when you are done. And with that learner we have come to the end of our Science and Technology lesson for today. I hope you have learnt how to make a floater sink and until next time it’s goodbye.
